profile.headline: Postdoctoral Researcher – AI-driven, resilient optical networks | Multi-band transport | Fiber sensing & fault detection

sections.label: Profile
sections.text: I'm a postdoctoral researcher at Politecnico di Torino (PLANET lab), working on AI-driven optical networks. My current focus is an AI-enabled digital twin for optical network design and planning, with LLMs integrated into the design and monitoring tools, together with AI for network monitoring and restoration. I'm also working on a fibre sensing project that uses State-of-Polarisation monitoring to detect and localise mechanical threats to fibre cables, with LLM-based support for network operators. More broadly, my research covers machine learning for failure prediction and anomaly detection, integrated sensing and communication in live metro networks, converged metro-access networks for 6G x-haul, and capacity scaling for future transport networks. My background is in multi-band transmission and ROADM/WSS architectures, and I work mainly with Python, MATLAB, C/C++, TensorFlow and GNPy. I received the IEEE Photonics Society Italian Chapter Best PhD Thesis Award (2024) and the Ambassador of Pakistan High Achievers Award (2026).

items.title: Postdoctoral researcher
items.sub: Politecnico di Torino, Torino, Italy
items.details:
- Fiber intrusion and fault detection: Developing a real-time ML framework, with Nokia, that monitors State of Polarization (SOP) to detect and classify mechanical threats to optical fiber cables (vibration, intrusion, physical stress). This enables proactive fault localization and cable protection.
- Capacity scaling for optical transport: Compared capacity-upgrade strategies (multi-band, multi-fiber/SDM, and transceiver upgrades) on cost and performance for future transport networks (IEEE OJCOMS 2025; OFC 2026).
- AI and LLMs for network operations: Co-developing LLM- and RAG-based tools for optical network design, telemetry interpretation, alarm correlation and intent-driven troubleshooting.
- Line systems and switching: Modelling multi-band transmission, ROADM architectures and switching granularity (wavelength, waveband and fiber) for metro, core and long-haul networks.
- Industry collaboration and mentoring: Managing joint research with Nokia and Top-IX, and mentoring 5 x PhD and 1 x MS researchers in optical networking and ML.

items.title: PhD Electrical Engineering
items.sub: Politecnico di Torino, Torino, Italy
lines: Thesis: Scaling Optical Transport using Multi-band Photonic Integrated Switching Systems
items.details:
- Investigated multi-band photonic switching to increase capacity and scalability in optical transport networks.
- Designed and evaluated photonic integrated wavelength-selective switch (WSS) architectures for ultra-wideband networks.
- Assessed network performance of ROADM architectures using multi-band WSS technology, including 800G transport applications.
- Conducted research in collaboration with Synopsys on photonic system design and simulation workflows.
- Received the 2024 IEEE Photonics Society Italian Chapter Best PhD Thesis Award.
